image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single daisy flower in focus against a blurred green background. The flower features a bright yellow central disc composed of tiny florets and a ring of white ray petals radiating outward. The petals are elongated and slightly overlapping. A slender green stem is partially visible below the flower head, connecting to out-of-focus foliage.
